title: Heart Emoji & Kaomoji: Copy & Paste ❤️ 💕 Love Combos
meta_description: Copy and paste heart emoji in every color ❤️ 💜 🖤, love kaomoji like (♥ω♥), and heart combos for captions, bios, and DMs. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Every heart emoji color, the beating and sparkling variants, love kaomoji, and one-click heart combos for bios, captions, and DMs. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The heart emoji is the most-sent symbol on the internet, and each color quietly says something different — 🖤 leans dark humor or goth rather than hate, 💜 doubles as the US Purple Heart military medal and a fandom staple, and 💛 signals platonic friendship on apps like Snapchat. This page gathers every heart color, the beating 💓, growing 💗, and sparkling 💖 variants, the broken-and-healing set 💔 ❤️‍🩹, heart-eyed faces like 😍 and 🥰, love kaomoji such as (♥ω♥), and one-click combo sets for captions, bios, and DMs. If you want the outline heart glyphs and card suits instead of full-color emoji, the heart symbols page linked below has the copy-paste set.
